title: Infinite Realms
description: Explore vast biomes, conquer dangerous structures, and journey through multiple dimensions in Infinite Realms — a survival adventure built for true explorers.
body:
# 🌌 Infinite Realms

Infinite Realms is an exploration-focused Minecraft modpack that expands survival with enhanced world generation, massive structures, powerful mobs, and multiple dimensions to conquer.

Designed for long-term adventure, the pack makes exploration meaningful again — every biome, ruin, and realm holds new challenges and discoveries. Whether playing solo or with friends, Infinite Realms delivers a bigger, more immersive survival experience.

Forge your path. Explore beyond. Conquer the unknown.

To ensure smooth gameplay in Infinite Realms, especially with expanded world generation and multiple dimensions:

## 🔹 Minimum

CPU: 4-core processor (Intel i5 8th gen / Ryzen 3 3000 or equivalent)

RAM: 8 GB system RAM

Allocated RAM: 4–6 GB to Minecraft

GPU: GTX 1050 / RX 560 or equivalent

Storage: HDD (SSD strongly recommended)

## 🔹 Recommended

CPU: 6-core processor (Intel i5 10th gen / Ryzen 5 3600 or better)

RAM: 16 GB system RAM

Allocated RAM: 6–8 GB to Minecraft

GPU: GTX 1660 / RX 580 or better

Storage: SSD (required for best world loading performance)

⚙ Notes

**Using shaders will require a stronger GPU.**                                                   
**Large multiplayer servers may require additional RAM allocation.**                                   
**First world generation may take longer due to expanded structures and dimensions.**
